title: California Code of Civil Procedure section 995.020 - Scope of the Bond and Undertaking Law
claims: Section 995.020(a) provides that the provisions of Chapter 2 (Bonds and Undertakings) of Title 14 of Part 2 of the Code of Civil Procedure apply to a bond or undertaking executed, filed, posted, furnished, or otherwise given as security pursuant to any statute of this state, except to the extent the statute prescribes a different rule or is inconsistent.

Section 995.020(b) provides that the chapter applies to a bond or undertaking given on or after January 1, 1983, or given before that date to the extent another surety is substituted or the principal gives a new, additional, or supplemental bond on or after that date.
Section 995.020(c) provides that the provisions of the chapter do not apply to a bail bond or an undertaking of bail.
